summary: iPhone 13 Pro (390x844) overflow retest. Hero H1 fix verified visually (RECONNAISSANCE wraps correctly within 358px, fully visible). However, Landing route STILL FAILS the scrollWidth<=innerWidth+2 invariant: body.scrollWidth=407 vs innerWidth=390 (17px overflow). All 5 OTHER routes pass with diff=0. No console errors anywhere. RCA: the fix only addressed the Hero H1; two OTHER long-tracking uppercase H2s on Landing still overflow the viewport: (a) SectionTitle h2 'STRATEX VISION (TM) - PHOTOGRAMMETRY MESH' produces sw=383 vs cw=342 (+41px) - this is the exact source of the 17px body overflow (24px section padding + 383 content = 407); (b) local h2 'DEPLOY YOUR FIRST AUTONOMOUS MISSION' overflows +15px inside a CTA card. Both share the same root cause as the original H1 - uppercase + tracking>=0.1em forces single-line longer than viewport-padding.

critical_code_review_comments: Pattern: every uppercase + wide-tracking heading on this app is at risk on small viewports. Consider centralising a `font-display-uppercase` utility that already includes overflow-wrap:anywhere + responsive tracking, rather than patching each h1/h2 individually.

The two failing h2s share visual style with the originally-fixed H1 - this suggests the iteration-7 RCA undercounted overflow sources. Audit ALL uppercase tracking-[0.1em+] headings across the app at 390px.

rca of the issue: DOM walk found body>div#root>App>Landing-wrapper>section.px-6 contains a max-w-[1500px]>div.mb-6>h2 whose scrollWidth (383px) exceeds its clientWidth (342px). Section horizontal padding is 24px on each side (px-6) -> visible right edge = 24 + 383 = 407 = body.scrollWidth. The h2 text 'STRATEX VISION (TM) - PHOTOGRAMMETRY MESH' is rendered uppercase with letter-spacing 0.16em and text-3xl (30px). At 390px viewport with 48px total side padding only 342px remain, but the longest single-word fragment ('PHOTOGRAMMETRY') at 30px*0.16em tracking measures ~383px and white-space wrapping does not break inside the word. Mitigation: add overflowWrap:'anywhere'+wordBreak:'break-word' AND/OR reduce mobile font-size/tracking (same fix shape already used on Hero H1 line 33).
